_comment: Shared config for pkprobe_send (us-east-2) and pkprobe_recv (Tokyo). The sender uses all fields; the receiver only uses base_port, num_lanes, output_dir. tokyo_ip MUST be the receiver's PRIVATE IP (VPC peering only routes private addresses). Add UDP base_port..base_port+num_lanes-1 to the Tokyo box's security group from the us-east-2 VPC CIDR.
